name: tpl-chain-response-3-nogoal
task: If the box falls, the very next move must pick it up again. If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires the agent to reach the exit (an unconditional command), but there is no hard Existence clause for at_exit. The current clauses only express the rules for the box and the exit, which means the machine has no FINAL_STATES and no goal is required. Add a hard Existence(at_exit) to the clauses. Note: the hard Existence(at_exit) will be forced by the Precedence logic if a chain were present, but since it's a lone command, it needs its own Existence.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) requires the agent to reach the exit; ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) ensures the box is picked up immediately after a fall; Response(at_exit, holding_box) ensures the box is held when the exit is reached. Together, these correctly capture the task requirements.
